sourceCoordinates: Source anchors use top-left pixels; exported poses use world XY units.
atlasCoordinates: Rects are bottom-left pixels. No trimming or per-frame scaling.
rootMotionScope: Camera follows rootPosition. Root translation is metadata, not baked canvas drift; bodyOffset/bodyAngle remain visible pose changes. Apply root travel once during playback.
headScope: Closed source head retained. jawProgress is metadata for a separately supplied overlay; this baker does not invent jaw art.
deathScope: Each source triangle belongs to one body/limb partition. Limbs separate once; no intact duplicate body or additional gibs are spawned.
limitations: Soft mesh deformation can shear skin near joints. Bone/contact checks do not prove visual quality, muscle volume, mouth anatomy or gameplay readiness.
